text:
Hi Professor Alvarez,

Following up on our hallway chat: could we set a 30-minute meeting for Wednesday at 10:00am?

You mentioned your faculty senate meeting that hour is cancelled this week, so the slot should be free for you even though it may still be showing on your calendar. If 10:00 Wednesday still works, would you add it on your side (or let me know and I'll send an invite)? Happy to move it if something else has come up.

Best,
Diego

Hello,

Could you confirm whether the faculty senate meeting this Wednesday (10:00-11:00) is cancelled for this week? A student is asking for that slot, and my calendar still shows it. If it is indeed cancelled, I'll take the meeting and remove the senate block from my schedule.

Thank you,
Professor Alvarez

Hi Diego,

Wednesday 10:00-10:30 should be fine — my calendar still shows the faculty senate meeting in that hour, so I'm having the department office confirm it's cancelled this week. I'll book it on my side and write back to you as soon as I hear from them.

Best,
Professor Alvarez

Hello Professor Alvarez,

The faculty senate meeting on Wednesday 10:00-11:00 is not cancelled. It is still on the official schedule for next week as listed, so your calendar is correct and that slot is not free.

Best,
CSE department office

Thanks — Wednesday 10:00-10:30 it is, then. I'll keep the slot free and wait for your word once the office confirms the senate meeting is off. If it turns out the meeting is on, just tell me and I'll shift to whatever else suits you that day.

Diego

Hi Diego,

I checked with the department office: the faculty senate meeting is *not* cancelled — it's still on the official schedule for Wednesday 10:00-11:00, so my calendar was right and 10:00 is not free. Sorry for the confusion after our hallway chat.

That day I could do 12:30-13:00 (right after my grant writing block) or 15:00-15:30 (after the department meeting). Say which suits you and I'll book it.

Best,
Professor Alvarez

Thank you for the confirmation — I've kept the senate meeting in place for Wednesday.

Professor Alvarez

No problem at all — thanks for checking rather than assuming.

12:30-13:00 on Wednesday suits me: let's do that one. I'll keep 30 minutes free then and wait for your booking.

Diego

Done — booked Wednesday 12:30-13:00 with you on my side. See you then.

Best,
Professor Alvarez
Great — see you Wednesday 12:30. Thanks for sorting it out.
